subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 13 refreshed third-party action pins as one exact-head update after all required checks complete?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but it replaces code executed with app keys, registry credentials, API keys, repository tokens, and security-scan permissions, so accepting that supply-chain boundary requires human owner intent.

options.title: Approve the exact head
options.body: Approve and merge the grouped immutable-pin update after all required checks pass on the reviewed SHA.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, Docker publishing, and security-scanning action updates if owners want narrower rollout and rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve the exact head
recommendation.body: Approve and merge the grouped immutable-pin update after all required checks pass on the reviewed SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the broadest ownership across the affected CI, release, action-runtime, and Codex-agent workflows.
